description: We are a team of passionate students interested in technology, AI, software development, and solving real-world problems using NASA’s open data. We are looking to build an innovative and impactful solution for the NASA Space Apps Challenge.If you're excited about space, Earth science, technology, and building something meaningful, we'd love to have you on our team! 🚀🌍
summary: We developed the "Earth Information Jukebox," a multimodal web application designed to bridge accessibility gaps in Earth science by converting NASA's visual datasets into real-time audio (sonification). Addressing the challenge of making space data accessible to visually impaired individuals, our system processes video frames of Earth phenomena like ISS lightning storms and dynamically maps visual brightness to audio frequencies. This allows users to "hear" the intensity of the data in real-time. This project is vital because it ensures that the awe and scientific value of Earth observation data are universally accessible, moving beyond purely visual dashboards to create an inclusive, multi-sensory experience.
details:
What it does & How it works: The Earth Information Jukebox streams NASA datasets through a custom React UI dashboard while a FastAPI backend processes the video feed frame by frame using OpenCV. It calculates the brightness ratio of the imagery (e.g., lightning flashes) and translates it into an audio waveform using the Web Audio API. Data is multiplexed over WebSockets to ensure flawless real time synchronization between the video timecode, the visual oscilloscope, and the generated audio.

Benefits & Impact: It provides an inclusive way to explore Earth science. Visually impaired users can understand data density and intensity through pitch and tone, and utilize the integrated Web Speech API screen reader for telemetry readouts.

Tools & Languages: React (Vite), Python (FastAPI, OpenCV, NumPy, Asyncio), WebSockets, Web Audio API, and Web Speech API.

Creativity: Instead of a static data chart, we built a "Jukebox" style operations deck with live timecodes, interactive scrubbing, and dynamic dataset switching, creating a highly engaging, cinematic mission control experience.

SI Tool Declaration: LLM tools were utilized as an interactive programming partner to assist with debugging WebSocket synchronization, configuring the React audio context, and formatting the UI operations deck.
